category: file transfer service (free with ads, paid packs)

free_tier.stated: Free transfers up to 10 Go per transfer, no account, 30 recipients, files available 14 days.
free_tier.notes: The page is in French; Go is gigabyte.

per_object_cap.stated: Sans pack, GrosFichiers permet d'envoyer gratuitement jusqu'à 10 Go par transfert. Avec un pack, la taille maximale passe à 50 Go par transfert.
per_object_cap.notes: bytes = 10 x 1024^3; the cap is per transfer, not per file.

retention.stated: Ceux-ci restent disponibles pendant 14 jours, avec possibilité de prolonger gratuitement leur disponibilité.
retention.notes: Availability can be extended for free.

egress.terms: The recipient downloads from an emailed link; no download byte cap is printed.

interface_detail: Web upload; links are delivered by email to up to 30 recipients.
chaining: A transfer needs a valid email address and mails a link to each recipient, so it suits one-off hand-off.

limits.value: 10 Go per transfer free, 50 Go with a pack

binding_note: 10 Go per transfer is the published free ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: 'Il suffit de disposer d'une adresse email valide pour envoyer vos fichiers.' No account is created.

reliability_note: The free service is funded by advertising; the Standard and Pro pack prices are on a separate page that was not read.
confidence_note: FAQ read on 2026-11-03. Pack prices unverified.
